arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from datetime import date, timedelta
today = date(2026, 8, 17)
print('today weekday:', today.strftime('%A'))
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)
print('next wednesday:', next_wed.isoformat(), next_wed.strftime('%A'))
"

python3 -c "
from icalendar import Calendar
cal = Calendar.from_ical(open('team_meeting.ics','rb').read())
for component in cal.walk():
    if component.name == 'VEVENT':
        print('Summary:', component.get('summary'))
        print('Start:', component.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('End:', component.get('dtend').dt)
        print('UID:', component.get('uid'))
print('ICS file is valid.')
" 2>&1 || echo "icalendar not installed - showing file contents instead" && cat team_meeting.ics
